messages:
mike: Heads up — Azure usage import for March shows ~12% less total usage than the marketplace report. Noticed after running the monthly recon. Can partners/billing take a look?
partners-bot: ALERT: ingestion job failed for blob azure/2026-03-01/usage.csv — partial parse error (rows parsed: 987, rows expected: 1116). JobID: job_az_ingest_4852
ashley: I pulled the raw blob. There are a handful of rows with timestamps like "2026-03-01T00:00:00" (no timezone) and our parser assumes UTC+0; looks like some provider SDK emitted local times for late-night events.
paul: FYI our entitlement mapping uses column plan_sku, but the marketplace CSV has plan_id. That mismatch will drop rows during mapping. Seen it before with partner vendor-sync v1.2.
lisa: sample offending row from blob: 
```
customer_id,plan_id,usage_units,usage_timestamp
cus_123,enterprise-annual,1200,2026-03-01T00:00:34
```
paul: that matches — parser tries to map plan_id -> plan_sku via mapping table `marketplace_plan_map`. If plan_id not present we currently discard the row (old behaviour). We should fallback to plan_name lookup before dropping.
ashley: also the timestamp handling caused a boundary shift: some events that should be 2026-03-01 00:00:xx UTC got normalized to previous day in our batch window, so monthly bucket lost them.
mike: ok action list: 1) re-ingest blob after fixing parser fallback mapping (owner: paul) 2) run a reconciliation query to estimate lost usage and create provisional credit notes if delta > $X (owner: ashley) 3) add automated alert for parse-discard > 0.5% of rows (owner: ops-bot / lisa).
paul: plan: add mapping fallback and instrument a metric `marketplace.parser.missing_plan_id` — will open PR today and add a migration to populate missing plan_id -> sku entries from partner catalog dump.
lisa: I can trigger reprocess once the parser image is bumped. Command I'll run: `./scripts/reprocess_blob.sh azure/2026-03-01/usage.csv --dry-run` then without --dry-run after approval.
ashley: reconciliation SQL I used for quick check: 
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(usage_units) as units
FROM marketplace_usages_staging
WHERE DATE(usage_timestamp) BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
ashley: comparing that to billing_report.total_units_by_customer we see the ~12% delta concentrated in enterprise-annual plan customers.
mike: good. please paste PR link and the reprocess job output when done. I've filed a partner incident ticket #P-2026-87 and pinged the vendor account team.
ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled re-ingest window available: 2026-03-05 04:00-05:00 UTC. Will reserve slot if requested.
paul: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace/pull/452 — adds fallback + metric.
lisa: running dry-run now (kicking job): `make marketplace-reingest BLOB=azure/2026-03-01/usage.csv DRY_RUN=1`
lisa: dry-run report: parsed_rows=1116, mapped_rows=1116, previously_mapped=987, newly_mapped=129, missing_plan_id=0 — looks good.
mike: awesome — go ahead with full reprocess in the ops window and keep receipts. After reprocess, Ashley please re-run invoices diff and decide if proforma credits needed.
ashley: will do, ETA EOD PT. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
